task_metadata.research_topic: classifier-free guidance design for latent diffusion text-to-image models
task_metadata.research_question: Design a better classifier-free guidance update for Stable Diffusion-family samplers that improves text-image alignment and sample quality across SD v1.5, SD v2.0 base, and SDXL.
notes: The task evaluates guidance changes on Stable Diffusion-family latent diffusion samplers using CLIP score as the primary metric and FID as a reported secondary metric.
No separate paper was located for the repo's `zeroinit` baseline; it is linked approximately to the CFG++ paper because the implementation is explicitly a CFG++ variant with skipped initial steps.

No distinct paper was identified from local task metadata for the specific Stable Diffusion 2 base checkpoint used by `sd20`, so that test is linked to the latent diffusion, DDIM, CFG, COCO, CLIP, and FID papers that document the model family and evaluation stack.

tests.label: sd15
tests.notes: SD v1.5 evaluation is grounded in latent diffusion architecture, classifier-free guidance, COCO prompts, CLIP scoring, and FID reporting.

tests.label: sd20
tests.notes: The task metadata names an SD 2.0 base checkpoint but does not cite a separate model paper, so this test is linked to the shared latent diffusion and evaluation literature.

tests.label: sdxl
tests.notes: SDXL evaluation maps directly to the SDXL architecture paper plus the same CFG, COCO, CLIP, and FID evaluation literature used elsewhere in the task.

baselines.name: cfg
baselines.notes: Standard classifier-free guidance maps directly to Ho and Salimans.

baselines.name: cfgpp
baselines.notes: Maps directly to the CFG++ method paper.

baselines.name: zeroinit
baselines.notes: The task defines `zeroinit` as a CFG++ variant with skipped initial steps; no separate paper was located, so it is linked approximately to the CFG++ source paper.

papers.title: Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance
papers.relevance: Introduces classifier-free guidance, the direct conceptual match for the `cfg` baseline and the core mechanism optimized by this task.

papers.title: CFG++: Manifold-constrained Classifier Free Guidance for Diffusion Models
papers.relevance: Introduces CFG++, the exact match for the `cfgpp` baseline and the closest documented source for the `zeroinit` variant used in this task.

papers.title: SDXL: Improving Latent Diffusion Models for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
papers.relevance: Provides the direct architecture reference for the SDXL evaluation target in this task.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
papers.relevance: The task edits DDIM-style sampling loops, so DDIM is directly relevant to the solver structure agents modify.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.relevance: Foundational diffusion-model paper for the denoising and reverse-process formalism underpinning the task's guidance updates.

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
papers.relevance: The task's main score is CLIP similarity between image and prompt, so this is the direct reference for the evaluation backbone.

papers.title: GANs Trained by a Two Time-Scale Update Rule Converge to a Local Nash Equilibrium
papers.relevance: Introduces Fréchet Inception Distance, which the task parser and batch evaluator report alongside CLIP score.
